faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF-JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 16th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the ANRF-JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Petroleum Engineering/Chemical Engineering/Fuel and Mineral Engineering with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or 60% marks. GATE or NET qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the ANRF-JRF position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- per month during the third year.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the ANRF-JRF post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ANRF-JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an email application followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an upper age limit for the ANRF-JRF position?
faq.answer: No, there is no upper age limit specified for this position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located at Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad, Jharkhand, with the pincode 826004.

faq.question: Q10. When is the tentative date for the interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the interview is 17th August 2026.
